description: As a shift supervisor of three employees, I was directly responsible for the maintenance and upkeep of twelve aircraft paint schemes.
Maintained an 0% accident rate in safety within my shop.
Prepare, type, and route correspondence and reports.
Receive office visits and handle telephone communications. Operate computers, word processing, and duplicating documents.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience as a supervisor in a corrosion control facility for the US Government, showcasing strong leadership and safety management skills. With roles involving aircraft paint schemes and adherence to strict technical manuals and safety procedures, there is evidence of reliability and professionalism.
